table inventory_movements  [rls=on force=off]
  allow_negative boolean not null default false
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  item_id uuid not null
  job_id uuid
  job_item_id uuid
  kind text not null
  organization_id uuid not null
  purchase_order_item_id uuid
  qty_milli bigint not null
  reason text not null
  unit_cost_minor bigint not null default 0
  constraint inventory_movements_allow_negative_not_null: NOT NULL allow_negative
  constraint inventory_movements_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint inventory_movements_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint inventory_movements_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint inventory_movements_item_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES inventory_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint inventory_movements_item_id_not_null: NOT NULL item_id
  constraint inventory_movements_item_org_fk: FOREIGN KEY (item_id, organization_id) REFERENCES inventory_items(id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint inventory_movements_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint inventory_movements_job_item_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_item_id) REFERENCES job_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint inventory_movements_kind_check: CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['receipt'::text, 'consumption'::text, 'adjustment'::text])))
  constraint inventory_movements_kind_not_null: NOT NULL kind
  constraint inventory_movements_kind_sign: CHECK ((((kind = 'receipt'::text) AND (qty_milli > 0)) OR ((kind = 'consumption'::text) AND (qty_milli < 0)) OR (kind = 'adjustment'::text)))
  constraint inventory_movements_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint inventory_movements_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint inventory_movements_override_reason: CHECK (((allow_negative = false) OR (length(btrim(reason)) >= 3)))
  constraint inventory_movements_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint inventory_movements_purchase_order_item_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (purchase_order_item_id) REFERENCES purchase_order_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint inventory_movements_qty_milli_check: CHECK ((qty_milli <> 0))
  constraint inventory_movements_qty_milli_not_null: NOT NULL qty_milli
  constraint inventory_movements_reason_check: CHECK ((length(btrim(reason)) > 0))
  constraint inventory_movements_reason_not_null: NOT NULL reason
  constraint inventory_movements_unit_cost_minor_check: CHECK ((unit_cost_minor >= 0))
  constraint inventory_movements_unit_cost_minor_not_null: NOT NULL unit_cost_minor
  index idx_inventory_movements_item: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_movements_item ON public.inventory_movements USING btree (item_id, created_at DESC)
  index idx_inventory_movements_job: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_movements_job ON public.inventory_movements USING btree (job_id) WHERE (job_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_inventory_movements_org: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_movements_org ON public.inventory_movements USING btree (organization_id, created_at DESC)
  index idx_inventory_movements_po_item: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_movements_po_item ON public.inventory_movements USING btree (purchase_order_item_id) WHERE (purchase_order_item_id IS NOT NULL)
  index inventory_movements_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inventory_movements_pkey ON public.inventory_movements USING btree (id)
  policy inventory_movements_insert: for INSERT to authenticated with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR ((created_by = auth.uid()) AND ((kind = 'consumption'::text) OR ((kind = 'adjustment'::text) AND (qty_milli > 0) AND (job_id IS NOT NULL)))))))
  policy inventory_movements_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (created_by = auth.uid()))))

table invitations  [rls=on force=off]
  accepted_at timestamp with time zone
  accepted_by uuid
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  delivery_error text
  delivery_status text not null default 'pending'::text
  email text not null
  expires_at timestamp with time zone not null default (now() + '7 days'::interval)
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  invited_by uuid
  organization_id uuid not null
  role user_role not null default 'tech'::user_role
  sent_at timestamp with time zone
  token text not null
  constraint invitations_accepted_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (accepted_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invitations_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint invitations_delivery_status_check: CHECK ((delivery_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'sent'::text, 'failed'::text, 'unavailable'::text])))
  constraint invitations_delivery_status_not_null: NOT NULL delivery_status
  constraint invitations_email_not_null: NOT NULL email
  constraint invitations_expires_at_not_null: NOT NULL expires_at
  constraint invitations_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint invitations_invited_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (invited_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invitations_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint invitations_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint invitations_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint invitations_role_not_null: NOT NULL role
  constraint invitations_token_key: UNIQUE (token)
  constraint invitations_token_not_null: NOT NULL token
  index idx_invitations_email_lower: CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_email_lower ON public.invitations USING btree (lower(email)) WHERE (accepted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_invitations_org: CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_org ON public.invitations USING btree (organization_id)
  index idx_invitations_token_open: CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_token_open ON public.invitations USING btree (token) WHERE (accepted_at IS NULL)
  index invitations_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invitations_pkey ON public.invitations USING btree (id)
  index invitations_token_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invitations_token_key ON public.invitations USING btree (token)
  policy invitations_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy invitations_write: for ALL to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role)))

table invoices  [rls=on force=off]
  archived boolean not null default false
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  credited_minor bigint not null default 0
  customer_id uuid not null
  deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  deleted_by uuid
  discount_minor bigint not null default 0
  estimate_id uuid
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  issue_date date not null default CURRENT_DATE
  job_id uuid
  method text
  notes text
  number integer not null
  organization_id uuid not null
  paid_at timestamp with time zone
  paid_online boolean not null default false
  public_token uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  sent_at timestamp with time zone
  signature_data text
  signature_ip inet
  signature_user_agent text
  signed_at timestamp with time zone
  signer_name text
  status invoice_status not null default 'unpaid'::invoice_status
  stripe_session_id text
  tax_rate_bps integer not null default 0
  total_minor bigint not null default 0
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  version integer not null default 1
  void_reason text
  voided_at timestamp with time zone
  voided_by uuid
  constraint invoices_archived_not_null: NOT NULL archived
  constraint invoices_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint invoices_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invoices_credited_minor_not_null: NOT NULL credited_minor
  constraint invoices_customer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint invoices_customer_id_not_null: NOT NULL customer_id
  constraint invoices_customer_org_fk: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint invoices_deleted_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (deleted_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invoices_discount_minor_check: CHECK ((discount_minor >= 0))
  constraint invoices_discount_minor_not_null: NOT NULL discount_minor
  constraint invoices_estimate_org_fk: FOREIGN KEY (estimate_id, organization_id) REFERENCES estimates(id, organization_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invoices_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint invoices_id_org_key: UNIQUE (id, organization_id)
  constraint invoices_issue_date_not_null: NOT NULL issue_date
  constraint invoices_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint invoices_number_not_null: NOT NULL number
  constraint invoices_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint invoices_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint invoices_organization_id_number_key: UNIQUE (organization_id, number)
  constraint invoices_paid_online_not_null: NOT NULL paid_online
  constraint invoices_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint invoices_public_token_key: UNIQUE (public_token)
  constraint invoices_public_token_not_null: NOT NULL public_token
  constraint invoices_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint invoices_tax_rate_bps_check: CHECK (((tax_rate_bps >= 0) AND (tax_rate_bps <= 100000)))
  constraint invoices_tax_rate_bps_not_null: NOT NULL tax_rate_bps
  constraint invoices_total_minor_check: CHECK ((total_minor >= 0))
  constraint invoices_total_minor_not_null: NOT NULL total_minor
  constraint invoices_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  constraint invoices_version_not_null: NOT NULL version
  constraint invoices_voided_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (voided_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  index idx_invoices_customer: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_customer ON public.invoices USING btree (customer_id)
  index idx_invoices_estimate: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_estimate ON public.invoices USING btree (estimate_id) WHERE (estimate_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_invoices_job: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_job ON public.invoices USING btree (job_id) WHERE ((job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index idx_invoices_org: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_org ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id)
  index idx_invoices_org_customer: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_org_customer ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, customer_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_invoices_org_issue: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_org_issue ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, issue_date)
  index idx_invoices_org_status: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_org_status ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, status) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_invoices_trash: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_trash ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, deleted_at DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_invoices_unpaid_issue: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_unpaid_issue ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, issue_date) WHERE ((status = 'unpaid'::invoice_status) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
  index idx_invoices_voided: CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_voided ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id) WHERE (voided_at IS NOT NULL)
  index invoices_id_org_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoices_id_org_key ON public.invoices USING btree (id, organization_id)
  index invoices_organization_id_number_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoices_organization_id_number_key ON public.invoices USING btree (organization_id, number)
  index invoices_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoices_pkey ON public.invoices USING btree (id)
  index invoices_public_token_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoices_public_token_key ON public.invoices USING btree (public_token)
  policy invoices_select: for SELECT to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy invoices_write: for ALL to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))

table job_actions  [rls=on force=off]
  action_type text not null
  assigned_to uuid
  body text
  completed_at timestamp with time zone
  completed_by uuid
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid not null
  due_at timestamp with time zone
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  job_id uuid not null
  organization_id uuid not null
  status text not null default 'open'::text
  title text not null
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint job_actions_action_type_check: CHECK ((action_type = ANY (ARRAY['note'::text, 'follow_up'::text])))
  constraint job_actions_action_type_not_null: NOT NULL action_type
  constraint job_actions_assigned_to_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint job_actions_completed_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (completed_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint job_actions_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint job_actions_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint job_actions_created_by_not_null: NOT NULL created_by
  constraint job_actions_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint job_actions_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint job_actions_job_id_not_null: NOT NULL job_id
  constraint job_actions_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint job_actions_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint job_actions_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint job_actions_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'done'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))
  constraint job_actions_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint job_actions_title_check: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 180)))
  constraint job_actions_title_not_null: NOT NULL title
  constraint job_actions_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_job_actions_due: CREATE INDEX idx_job_actions_due ON public.job_actions USING btree (organization_id, status, due_at) WHERE (status = 'open'::text)
  index idx_job_actions_timeline: CREATE INDEX idx_job_actions_timeline ON public.job_actions USING btree (job_id, created_at DESC)
  index job_actions_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_actions_pkey ON public.job_actions USING btree (id)
  policy job_actions_manage: for ALL to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy job_actions_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM jobs j
  WHERE ((j.id = job_actions.job_id) AND ((j.assigned_to = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM job_assignments a
          WHERE ((a.job_id = j.id) AND (a.profile_id = auth.uid())))))))))))
  policy job_actions_tech_note_insert: for INSERT to authenticated with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (created_by = auth.uid()) AND (action_type = 'note'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM jobs j
  WHERE ((j.id = job_actions.job_id) AND ((j.assigned_to = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM job_assignments a
          WHERE ((a.job_id = j.id) AND (a.profile_id = auth.uid()))))))))))

  index uq_job_assignment_profile: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_job_assignment_profile ON public.job_assignments USING btree (job_id, profile_id) WHERE (profile_id IS NOT NULL)

  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()

  is_done boolean not null default false

  organization_id uuid not null
  sort integer not null default 0
  constraint job_statuses_color_not_null: NOT NULL color
  constraint job_statuses_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint job_statuses_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint job_statuses_is_cancelled_not_null: NOT NULL is_cancelled
  constraint job_statuses_is_done_not_null: NOT NULL is_done
  constraint job_statuses_name_not_null: NOT NULL name
  constraint job_statuses_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint job_statuses_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint job_statuses_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint job_statuses_sort_not_null: NOT NULL sort
  index idx_job_statuses_org: CREATE INDEX idx_job_statuses_org ON public.job_statuses USING btree (organization_id, sort)
  index job_statuses_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_statuses_pkey ON public.job_statuses USING btree (id)
  policy job_statuses_select: for SELECT to public using ((organization_id = current_org_id()))
  policy job_statuses_write: for ALL to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))

   FROM jobs j

  constraint job_warranties_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint job_warranties_starts_on_not_null: NOT NULL starts_on
  constraint job_warranties_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'expired'::text, 'void'::text])))
  constraint job_warranties_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint job_warranties_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_job_warranties_expiry: CREATE INDEX idx_job_warranties_expiry ON public.job_warranties USING btree (organization_id, status, expires_on)

  index job_warranties_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_warranties_pkey ON public.job_warranties USING btree (id)

table jobs  [rls=on force=off]
  arrived_at timestamp with time zone
  assigned_to uuid
  completed_at timestamp with time zone
  completion_signature text
  completion_signed_by text
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  customer_confirmation_note text
  customer_confirmation_status text not null default 'pending'::text
  customer_confirmed_at timestamp with time zone
  customer_declined_at timestamp with time zone
  customer_id uuid not null
  customer_response_count integer not null default 0
  deleted_at timestamp with time zone
  deleted_by uuid
  end_date date not null
  end_time time without time zone
  external_id text
  external_source text
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  is_warranty_callback boolean not null default false
  job_address text
  job_city text
  job_expenses_minor bigint not null default 0
  labour_cost_minor bigint not null default 0
  labour_costed_at timestamp with time zone
  labour_minutes integer not null default 0
  migration_batch_id uuid
  notes text
  on_my_way_at timestamp with time zone
  on_my_way_eta_minutes integer
  organization_id uuid not null
  parent_job_id uuid
  price_minor bigint not null default 0
  required_skills text[] not null default '{}'::text[]
  sample_batch_id uuid
  scheduled_date date not null
  service text not null
  slot tsrange default 
CASE
    WHEN ((start_time IS NOT NULL) AND (end_time IS NOT NULL)) THEN tsrange((scheduled_date + start_time), (scheduled_date + end_time), '[)'::text)
    ELSE NULL::tsrange
END
  source text
  stage text not null default 'Scheduled'::text
  stage_changed_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  start_time time without time zone
  started_at timestamp with time zone
  status job_status not null default 'scheduled'::job_status
  tags text[] not null default '{}'::text[]
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint jobs_assigned_to_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint jobs_check: CHECK (((end_time IS NULL) OR (start_time IS NULL) OR (end_time > start_time)))
  constraint jobs_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint jobs_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint jobs_customer_confirmation_status_check: CHECK ((customer_confirmation_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'declined'::text])))
  constraint jobs_customer_confirmation_status_not_null: NOT NULL customer_confirmation_status
  constraint jobs_customer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint jobs_customer_id_not_null: NOT NULL customer_id
  constraint jobs_customer_org_fk: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint jobs_customer_response_count_not_null: NOT NULL customer_response_count
  constraint jobs_deleted_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (deleted_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint jobs_end_date_after_start: CHECK ((end_date >= scheduled_date))
  constraint jobs_end_date_not_null: NOT NULL end_date
  constraint jobs_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint jobs_id_org_key: UNIQUE (id, organization_id)
  constraint jobs_is_warranty_callback_not_null: NOT NULL is_warranty_callback
  constraint jobs_job_expenses_minor_check: CHECK ((job_expenses_minor >= 0))
  constraint jobs_job_expenses_minor_not_null: NOT NULL job_expenses_minor
  constraint jobs_labour_cost_minor_check: CHECK ((labour_cost_minor >= 0))
  constraint jobs_labour_cost_minor_not_null: NOT NULL labour_cost_minor
  constraint jobs_labour_minutes_check: CHECK ((labour_minutes >= 0))
  constraint jobs_labour_minutes_not_null: NOT NULL labour_minutes
  constraint jobs_migration_batch_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (migration_batch_id) REFERENCES migration_batches(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint jobs_no_double_book: EXCLUDE USING gist (organization_id WITH =, assigned_to WITH =, slot WITH &&) WHERE (((status <> 'cancelled'::job_status) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (assigned_to IS NOT NULL) AND (slot IS NOT NULL)))
  constraint jobs_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint jobs_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint jobs_parent_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (parent_job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint jobs_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint jobs_price_minor_check: CHECK ((price_minor >= 0))
  constraint jobs_price_minor_not_null: NOT NULL price_minor
  constraint jobs_required_skills_not_null: NOT NULL required_skills
  constraint jobs_scheduled_date_not_null: NOT NULL scheduled_date
  constraint jobs_service_not_null: NOT NULL service
  constraint jobs_stage_changed_at_not_null: NOT NULL stage_changed_at
  constraint jobs_stage_not_null: NOT NULL stage
  constraint jobs_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint jobs_tags_not_null: NOT NULL tags
  constraint jobs_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_jobs_assigned: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_assigned ON public.jobs USING btree (assigned_to)
  index idx_jobs_customer: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_customer ON public.jobs USING btree (customer_id)
  index idx_jobs_date: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_date ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, scheduled_date)
  index idx_jobs_org_customer: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_org_customer ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, customer_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_jobs_org_date_assigned: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_org_date_assigned ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, scheduled_date, assigned_to) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (start_time IS NOT NULL))
  index idx_jobs_org_date_range: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_org_date_range ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, scheduled_date, end_date) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_jobs_org_status: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_org_status ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, status) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_jobs_parent_job: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_parent_job ON public.jobs USING btree (parent_job_id) WHERE (parent_job_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_jobs_required_skills: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_required_skills ON public.jobs USING gin (required_skills)
  index idx_jobs_stage: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_stage ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, stage)
  index idx_jobs_tags: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_tags ON public.jobs USING gin (tags)
  index idx_jobs_tech_date: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_tech_date ON public.jobs USING btree (assigned_to, scheduled_date) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
  index idx_jobs_trash: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_trash ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, deleted_at DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
  index jobs_id_org_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_id_org_key ON public.jobs USING btree (id, organization_id)
  index jobs_no_double_book: CREATE INDEX jobs_no_double_book ON public.jobs USING gist (organization_id, assigned_to, slot) WHERE ((status <> 'cancelled'::job_status) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (assigned_to IS NOT NULL) AND (slot IS NOT NULL))
  index jobs_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON public.jobs USING btree (id)
  index uq_jobs_external_source: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_jobs_external_source ON public.jobs USING btree (organization_id, external_source, external_id)
  policy jobs_insert: for INSERT to public with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy jobs_select: for SELECT to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid()))))
  policy jobs_update: for UPDATE to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid())))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid()))))

table leads  [rls=on force=off]
  address text
  booking_answers jsonb not null default jsonb_build_object()
  booking_reference text
  booking_service_id uuid
  booking_status text not null default 'requested'::text
  campaign text
  city text
  contact_preference text
  converted_customer_id uuid
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  deposit_estimate_id uuid
  email text
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  name text not null
  notes text
  organization_id uuid not null
  phone text
  postal_code text
  preferred_date date
  preferred_start_time time without time zone
  preferred_window_min integer
  service text
  source text default 'Online booking'::text
  status text not null default 'new'::text
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  urgency text
  constraint leads_booking_answers_not_null: NOT NULL booking_answers
  constraint leads_booking_service_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (booking_service_id) REFERENCES booking_services(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint leads_booking_status_not_null: NOT NULL booking_status
  constraint leads_converted_customer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (converted_customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint leads_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint leads_deposit_estimate_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (deposit_estimate_id) REFERENCES estimates(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint leads_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint leads_name_check: CHECK ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) > 0))
  constraint leads_name_not_null: NOT NULL name
  constraint leads_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint leads_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint leads_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint leads_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['new'::text, 'contacted'::text, 'quoted'::text, 'won'::text, 'lost'::text])))
  constraint leads_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint leads_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_leads_deposit_estimate: CREATE INDEX idx_leads_deposit_estimate ON public.leads USING btree (deposit_estimate_id) WHERE (deposit_estimate_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_leads_org: CREATE INDEX idx_leads_org ON public.leads USING btree (organization_id, status)
  index idx_leads_org_created: CREATE INDEX idx_leads_org_created ON public.leads USING btree (organization_id, created_at DESC)
  index leads_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX leads_pkey ON public.leads USING btree (id)

  policy payment_events_owner_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role)))

table payment_requests  [rls=on force=off]
  allowed_methods text[] not null default ARRAY['card'::text, 'ach'::text]

  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  currency text not null default 'USD'::text
  document_type text not null
  estimate_id uuid

  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint payment_requests_allowed_methods_check: CHECK ((allowed_methods <@ ARRAY['card'::text, 'ach'::text, 'zelle'::text, 'check'::text]))
  constraint payment_requests_allowed_methods_not_null: NOT NULL allowed_methods
  constraint payment_requests_amount_minor_check: CHECK ((amount_minor > 0))

  constraint payment_requests_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at

  constraint payment_requests_currency_not_null: NOT NULL currency

  constraint payment_requests_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

  constraint payment_requests_public_token_not_null: NOT NULL public_token
  constraint payment_requests_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'action_required'::text, 'submitted'::text, 'processing'::text, 'partially_paid'::text, 'paid'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text, 'partially_refunded'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'disputed'::text])))
  constraint payment_requests_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint payment_requests_tip_check: CHECK (((tip_minor >= 0) AND (tip_minor <= amount_minor)))
  constraint payment_requests_tip_minor_not_null: NOT NULL tip_minor
  constraint payment_requests_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_payment_requests_active_estimate_checkout: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payment_requests_active_estimate_checkout ON public.payment_requests USING btree (estimate_id) WHERE ((estimate_id IS NOT NULL) AND (milestone_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'action_required'::text, 'processing'::text])) AND (allowed_methods && ARRAY['card'::text, 'ach'::text]))
  index idx_payment_requests_active_invoice_checkout: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payment_requests_active_invoice_checkout ON public.payment_requests USING btree (invoice_id) WHERE ((invoice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (milestone_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'action_required'::text, 'processing'::text])) AND (allowed_methods && ARRAY['card'::text, 'ach'::text]))
  index idx_payment_requests_document: CREATE INDEX idx_payment_requests_document ON public.payment_requests USING btree (estimate_id, invoice_id)
  index idx_payment_requests_id_org: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payment_requests_id_org ON public.payment_requests USING btree (id, organization_id)

table payments  [rls=on force=off]
  amount_minor bigint not null
  base_amount_minor bigint not null
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  currency text not null default 'USD'::text
  estimate_id uuid
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  invoice_id uuid
  method text
  normalized_status text not null
  note text
  organization_id uuid not null
  paid_at timestamp with time zone
  payment_request_id uuid
  provider text not null
  provider_transaction_id text
  reference text
  refunded_minor bigint not null default 0
  settled_at timestamp with time zone
  status text not null default 'requires_payment'::text
  stripe_payment_intent_id text
  submitted_at timestamp with time zone
  surcharge_minor bigint not null default 0
  tip_minor bigint not null default 0
  constraint payments_amount_minor_check: CHECK ((amount_minor >= 0))
  constraint payments_amount_minor_not_null: NOT NULL amount_minor
  constraint payments_amount_parts_check: CHECK (((base_amount_minor >= 0) AND (surcharge_minor >= 0) AND (tip_minor >= 0) AND (refunded_minor >= 0)))
  constraint payments_base_amount_minor_not_null: NOT NULL base_amount_minor
  constraint payments_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint payments_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint payments_currency_not_null: NOT NULL currency
  constraint payments_estimate_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (estimate_id) REFERENCES estimates(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint payments_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint payments_id_org_key: UNIQUE (id, organization_id)
  constraint payments_invoice_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint payments_normalized_status_check: CHECK ((normalized_status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'action_required'::text, 'submitted'::text, 'processing'::text, 'settled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'partially_refunded'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'disputed'::text])))
  constraint payments_normalized_status_not_null: NOT NULL normalized_status
  constraint payments_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint payments_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint payments_payment_request_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (payment_request_id) REFERENCES payment_requests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint payments_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint payments_provider_not_null: NOT NULL provider
  constraint payments_refunded_minor_not_null: NOT NULL refunded_minor
  constraint payments_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint payments_stripe_payment_intent_id_key: UNIQUE (stripe_payment_intent_id)
  constraint payments_surcharge_minor_not_null: NOT NULL surcharge_minor
  constraint payments_tip_minor_not_null: NOT NULL tip_minor
  index idx_payments_estimate: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_estimate ON public.payments USING btree (estimate_id, settled_at)
  index idx_payments_in_flight: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_in_flight ON public.payments USING btree (organization_id, normalized_status) WHERE (normalized_status = 'processing'::text)
  index idx_payments_invoice: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_invoice ON public.payments USING btree (invoice_id)
  index idx_payments_org_paid: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_org_paid ON public.payments USING btree (organization_id, paid_at)
  index idx_payments_org_paid_at: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_org_paid_at ON public.payments USING btree (organization_id, paid_at DESC)
  index idx_payments_provider_transaction: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payments_provider_transaction ON public.payments USING btree (organization_id, provider, provider_transaction_id) WHERE (provider_transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_payments_request: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_request ON public.payments USING btree (payment_request_id)
  index payments_id_org_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_id_org_key ON public.payments USING btree (id, organization_id)
  index payments_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_pkey ON public.payments USING btree (id)
  index payments_stripe_payment_intent_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_stripe_payment_intent_id_key ON public.payments USING btree (stripe_payment_intent_id)
  policy payments_rw: for ALL to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))

table permission_change_log  [rls=on force=off]
  actor_profile_id uuid
  at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  changes jsonb not null
  id bigint not null

table profiles  [rls=on force=off]
  active boolean not null default true

  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()

  id uuid not null
  notify_email text
  notify_email_opt_in boolean not null default true
  notify_push_opt_in boolean not null default true
  organization_id uuid
  phone text
  role user_role not null default 'owner'::user_role
  ui_contrast text not null default 'normal'::text
  ui_reduce_motion boolean not null default false
  ui_text_scale text not null default 'normal'::text
  ui_theme text not null default 'system'::text
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint profiles_active_not_null: NOT NULL active
  constraint profiles_commission_pct_check: CHECK (((commission_pct >= 0) AND (commission_pct <= 100)))
  constraint profiles_commission_pct_not_null: NOT NULL commission_pct
  constraint profiles_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint profiles_full_name_not_null: NOT NULL full_name
  constraint profiles_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint profiles_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint profiles_id_org_key: UNIQUE (id, organization_id)
  constraint profiles_notify_email_opt_in_not_null: NOT NULL notify_email_opt_in
  constraint profiles_notify_push_opt_in_not_null: NOT NULL notify_push_opt_in
  constraint profiles_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint profiles_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint profiles_role_not_null: NOT NULL role
  constraint profiles_ui_contrast_check: CHECK ((ui_contrast = ANY (ARRAY['normal'::text, 'high'::text])))
  constraint profiles_ui_contrast_not_null: NOT NULL ui_contrast
  constraint profiles_ui_reduce_motion_not_null: NOT NULL ui_reduce_motion
  constraint profiles_ui_text_scale_check: CHECK ((ui_text_scale = ANY (ARRAY['normal'::text, 'large'::text])))
  constraint profiles_ui_text_scale_not_null: NOT NULL ui_text_scale
  constraint profiles_ui_theme_check: CHECK ((ui_theme = ANY (ARRAY['light'::text, 'dark'::text, 'system'::text])))
  constraint profiles_ui_theme_not_null: NOT NULL ui_theme
  constraint profiles_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  index idx_profiles_org: CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_org ON public.profiles USING btree (organization_id)
  index profiles_id_org_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_id_org_key ON public.profiles USING btree (id, organization_id)
  index profiles_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_pkey ON public.profiles USING btree (id)
  policy profiles_owner_write: for ALL to public using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role)))
  policy profiles_select: for SELECT to public using ((organization_id = current_org_id()))
  policy profiles_self_update: for UPDATE to authenticated using ((id = auth.uid())) with check (((id = auth.uid()) AND (organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (role = ( SELECT p.role
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (active = ( SELECT p.active
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (commission_pct = ( SELECT p.commission_pct
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid())))))

  constraint support_sessions_revoked_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (revoked_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint support_sessions_starts_at_not_null: NOT NULL starts_at
  index support_sessions_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX support_sessions_pkey ON public.support_sessions USING btree (id)

table tax_filings  [rls=on force=off]
  confirmation_reference text
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  due_on date
  exempt_sales_minor bigint not null default 0
  filed_on date
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  notes text
  organization_id uuid not null
  period_end date not null
  period_start date not null
  status text not null default 'open'::text
  tax_collected_minor bigint not null default 0
  tax_remitted_minor bigint not null default 0
  taxable_sales_minor bigint not null default 0
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  constraint tax_filings_check: CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
  constraint tax_filings_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint tax_filings_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint tax_filings_exempt_sales_minor_check: CHECK ((exempt_sales_minor >= 0))
  constraint tax_filings_exempt_sales_minor_not_null: NOT NULL exempt_sales_minor
  constraint tax_filings_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint tax_filings_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint tax_filings_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint tax_filings_organization_id_period_start_period_end_key: UNIQUE (organization_id, period_start, period_end)
  constraint tax_filings_period_end_not_null: NOT NULL period_end
  constraint tax_filings_period_start_not_null: NOT NULL period_start
  constraint tax_filings_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint tax_filings_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'ready'::text, 'filed'::text, 'paid'::text, 'overdue'::text])))
  constraint tax_filings_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint tax_filings_tax_collected_minor_check: CHECK ((tax_collected_minor >= 0))
  constraint tax_filings_tax_collected_minor_not_null: NOT NULL tax_collected_minor
  constraint tax_filings_tax_remitted_minor_check: CHECK ((tax_remitted_minor >= 0))
  constraint tax_filings_tax_remitted_minor_not_null: NOT NULL tax_remitted_minor

table technician_time_off  [rls=on force=off]
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  end_time time without time zone
  ends_on date not null
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  kind text not null default 'time_off'::text
  note text
  organization_id uuid not null
  profile_id uuid
  start_time time without time zone
  starts_on date not null
  status text not null default 'approved'::text
  constraint technician_time_off_check: CHECK ((ends_on >= starts_on))
  constraint technician_time_off_check1: CHECK ((((start_time IS NULL) AND (end_time IS NULL)) OR ((start_time IS NOT NULL) AND (end_time IS NOT NULL) AND (end_time > start_time))))
  constraint technician_time_off_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint technician_time_off_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint technician_time_off_ends_on_not_null: NOT NULL ends_on
  constraint technician_time_off_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint technician_time_off_kind_check: CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['time_off'::text, 'vacation'::text, 'sick'::text, 'personal'::text, 'training'::text, 'holiday'::text, 'other'::text])))
  constraint technician_time_off_kind_not_null: NOT NULL kind
  constraint technician_time_off_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint technician_time_off_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint technician_time_off_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint technician_time_off_profile_id_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (profile_id, organization_id) REFERENCES profiles(id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint technician_time_off_starts_on_not_null: NOT NULL starts_on
  constraint technician_time_off_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'approved'::text, 'declined'::text])))
  constraint technician_time_off_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  index idx_time_off_org_range: CREATE INDEX idx_time_off_org_range ON public.technician_time_off USING btree (organization_id, starts_on, ends_on) WHERE (status = 'approved'::text)
  index idx_time_off_profile: CREATE INDEX idx_time_off_profile ON public.technician_time_off USING btree (profile_id, starts_on, ends_on)
  index technician_time_off_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX technician_time_off_pkey ON public.technician_time_off USING btree (id)
  policy technician_time_off_manage: for ALL to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy technician_time_off_request: for INSERT to authenticated with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (profile_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'requested'::text)))
  policy technician_time_off_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])) OR (profile_id = auth.uid()) OR (profile_id IS NULL))))

table warranty_callbacks  [rls=on force=off]
  callback_job_id uuid
  created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  created_by uuid
  customer_id uuid not null
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  internal_cost_minor bigint not null default 0
  issue text not null
  organization_id uuid not null
  original_job_id uuid not null
  priority text not null default 'normal'::text
  reported_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  resolution text
  resolved_at timestamp with time zone
  resolved_by uuid
  responsibility text not null default 'review'::text
  scheduled_for date
  status text not null default 'reported'::text
  updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  warranty_id uuid
  constraint warranty_callbacks_callback_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (callback_job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint warranty_callbacks_callback_job_id_key: UNIQUE (callback_job_id)
  constraint warranty_callbacks_created_at_not_null: NOT NULL created_at
  constraint warranty_callbacks_created_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint warranty_callbacks_customer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint warranty_callbacks_customer_id_not_null: NOT NULL customer_id
  constraint warranty_callbacks_id_not_null: NOT NULL id
  constraint warranty_callbacks_internal_cost_minor_check: CHECK ((internal_cost_minor >= 0))
  constraint warranty_callbacks_internal_cost_minor_not_null: NOT NULL internal_cost_minor
  constraint warranty_callbacks_issue_check: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM issue)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM issue)) <= 4000)))
  constraint warranty_callbacks_issue_not_null: NOT NULL issue
  constraint warranty_callbacks_organization_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint warranty_callbacks_organization_id_not_null: NOT NULL organization_id
  constraint warranty_callbacks_original_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (original_job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  constraint warranty_callbacks_original_job_id_not_null: NOT NULL original_job_id
  constraint warranty_callbacks_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint warranty_callbacks_priority_check: CHECK ((priority = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'normal'::text, 'urgent'::text])))
  constraint warranty_callbacks_priority_not_null: NOT NULL priority
  constraint warranty_callbacks_reported_at_not_null: NOT NULL reported_at
  constraint warranty_callbacks_resolved_by_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint warranty_callbacks_responsibility_check: CHECK ((responsibility = ANY (ARRAY['review'::text, 'covered'::text, 'customer'::text, 'manufacturer'::text, 'third_party'::text])))
  constraint warranty_callbacks_responsibility_not_null: NOT NULL responsibility
  constraint warranty_callbacks_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'scheduled'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'resolved'::text, 'denied'::text])))
  constraint warranty_callbacks_status_not_null: NOT NULL status
  constraint warranty_callbacks_updated_at_not_null: NOT NULL updated_at
  constraint warranty_callbacks_warranty_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (warranty_id) REFERENCES job_warranties(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  index idx_warranty_callbacks_original: CREATE INDEX idx_warranty_callbacks_original ON public.warranty_callbacks USING btree (original_job_id, created_at DESC)
  index idx_warranty_callbacks_queue: CREATE INDEX idx_warranty_callbacks_queue ON public.warranty_callbacks USING btree (organization_id, status, reported_at DESC)
  index warranty_callbacks_callback_job_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX warranty_callbacks_callback_job_id_key ON public.warranty_callbacks USING btree (callback_job_id)
  index warranty_callbacks_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX warranty_callbacks_pkey ON public.warranty_callbacks USING btree (id)
  policy warranty_callbacks_manage: for ALL to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role])))) with check (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
  policy warranty_callbacks_select: for SELECT to authenticated using (((organization_id = current_org_id()) AND (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::user_role, 'office'::user_role]))))
